meta.title: Skyfall: The Birthday Jump

victim.name: Theo Marsh
victim.description: A thrill-seeking tech founder who organised the skydive for his birthday and paid for everything.

meta.tone: tense, breathless, high-altitude suspense with wind and adrenaline
meta.premise: A group of friends go skydiving together. One of them dies when their parachute fails to open. The rest must work out who sabotaged it before they land.

suspects.name: Lena Okafor
suspects.description: Theo's co-founder and chief engineer. Cool, precise, and furious about the sale of their company.
suspects.public_alibi: Says she spent last night in the hotel bar with Theo's film crew, then rode the shuttle straight to the airstrip.
suspects.motive: Theo planned to sell their company next week, over her loud objections.

suspects.name: Dash Pryce
suspects.description: Theo's oldest friend and a veteran jump coach with a big laugh and a bigger past.
suspects.public_alibi: Says he slept at the lodge and never touched Theo's gear; the rig came packed and sealed.
suspects.motive: His jump school survives on Theo's money, and he owes Theo a small fortune.

world.killer_method: Dash re-packed Theo's main canopy with a fouled bridle the night before, then switched off the reserve's automatic safety device with his rigger's key during the boarding check, so both layers failed.

clues.text: Theo's logbook lists last night's pack job, signed by Dash. Dash swore he never touched this rig.
Only a rigger's key can switch off a rig's safety device. Dash is the only rigger aboard.
Theo found Dash's jump school accounts short by six figures. He planned to confront Dash after the jump.
At boarding, Dash waved off the ground crew's gear checker and checked Theo's reserve flap himself. He lingered there far longer than a routine check needs.
The hangar log shows Dash let himself in at 11:30 last night. He swore he was asleep at the lodge.
Theo's phone holds a furious text from Lena: "Sign that sale and you'll regret it." She never mentioned it.

items.name: Cabin Camera Card
items.description: The memory card from the cabin camera. It recorded everything since boarding.

items.name: Birthday Carabiner
items.description: Theo's scuffed carabiner charm on a ribbon. Holding it steadies shaking hands.

scenes.intro: The wheels slam onto the runway. Sirens rise from every side. Whatever you hold, you must play it now.

on_success.narration: The words come out in a rush, but nothing sticks. The police look unconvinced.

on_failure.narration: The words tangle in the sirens. The police wave everyone toward the terminal.

on_success.narration: The loudest motive draws blame, but none of it holds. The police drift away.

solved.title: Grounded
solved.epilogue: The card plays on the cabin screen, and the cabin falls silent. {killer} is on the footage, thumbing a switch on Theo's rig at the door. {victim} had found the missing money and meant to expose it at his own birthday dinner. The police are waiting on the runway when the door finally opens.

wrong_culprit.title: Blame Lands First
wrong_culprit.epilogue: The cabin is certain, and certainty is loud. The police lead Lena away, still protesting, for a crime she never committed. {killer} watches from the back, silent and relieved. {victim}'s secret falls with him, and the truth stays buried. By sunset the case is closed.

culprit_escapes.title: Clean Landing
culprit_escapes.epilogue: The wheels stop turning, and the cabin has nothing solid to offer. {killer} steps onto the runway with a steady stride. The police take statements, shrug, and write the word accident. {victim}'s rig is gone, and so is the proof.
culprit_escapes.epilogue_if_downgraded: The truth was in the cabin, within reach of everyone aboard. The final move never landed, and the moment was gone. {killer} walks away clean, and {victim} becomes a line in a file marked accident. {survivors} will replay that last minute for years.
